audit.whatIsWrong: The chart gave Irelia level 1 and gave you levels 3, 4-5, first item and two items — the exact reverse of whys[0] ('You own level 1'), whys[2] ('Irelia edges it'), whys[3], whys[5] and whys[6] ('it stays a skill check').
audit.why: At level 1 she is a melee with no Bladesurge reset target; from level 3 she resets through minions, Defiant Dance blunts your burst, and Trinity plus Ionian Fervor out-DPS you until two items even it out.
audit.corrected: Jayce, Skill, Irelia, Irelia, Irelia, Irelia, Skill.

audit.whatIsWrong: phases[4].why used the 'Irelia's ultimate changes the math too' boilerplate.
audit.why: Her real level-6 spike is Trinity plus Vanguard's Edge (125s at rank 1); yours is nothing, because Mercury Cannon/Hammer is the stance-swap you already had.
audit.corrected: Level 6 named as hers with the reason.

audit.whatIsWrong: Defiant Dance is described as blunting your whole combo, and the damage types are never separated.
audit.why: Riot: Defiant Dance reduces PHYSICAL damage while she charges. Shock Blast and To the Skies! are physical, but Thundering Blow deals MAGIC damage — so her W does nothing against the knockback. Charging W also holds her still, which is the moment your accelerated orb cannot miss.
audit.corrected: Fire the orb into the charge, and knock her with Thundering Blow through the W.

audit.whatIsWrong: 'Track Flawless Duet' appears throughout with no number.
audit.why: Flawless Duet is 16/14.5/13/11.5/10s, Bladesurge 10s at rank 1 but refreshed on a Marked target or a kill, and Defiant Dance 20s at rank 1.
audit.corrected: Numbers written into breakdown.cooldowns and the do.

edits.before: She has Defiant Dance to reduce your swap-burst and her Q-reset heals to out-sustain your poke, grinding down your squishy ranged frame.
edits.after: Defiant Dance cuts your physical burst — though not Thundering Blow's magic damage — and her Q-reset heals out-sustain your poke.

edits.before: This is where it slips. Once she has Q-W-E plus a Sheen/Trinity proc she closes your gate-Q gap by Bladesurging through the caster minion, her Defiant Dance damage-reduction blunts your Cannon-Q-into-Hammer burst, and her stacked Ionian Fervor on-hit shreds you in the follow-up. Your level 6 is a non-spike — R is just the stance swap you already had — so she reclaims the window outright. Respect the E stun; if she lands it you are dead through the full reset chain. Your one real tool is Thundering Blow: hold it to knock her off the moment she dashes in, then kite in Cannon on your Hextech Capacitor speed.
edits.after: This is where it slips. Once she has Q-W-E plus a Sheen/Trinity proc she closes your gate-Q gap by Bladesurging through the caster minion, her Defiant Dance blunts the physical half of your burst, and her stacked Ionian Fervor on-hit shreds you in the follow-up. Your level 6 is a non-spike — R is just the stance swap you already had — so she reclaims the window outright. Respect the 16s E stun; if she lands it you are dead through the full reset chain. Thundering Blow is magic damage, so Defiant Dance does not soften it — hold it for the instant she dashes in, then kite in Cannon on your Hextech Capacitor speed.

edits.before: Cannon Q-poke wins range wars before minions even matter. Identify how Irelia contests the first waves before you commit anything.
edits.after: Cannon Q out-ranges a melee Irelia who has no Bladesurge reset target yet — she eats the orb every time she steps up to farm.

edits.before: Full kit online — your core pattern starts now. Keep the wave near your side so Irelia must walk into your range.
edits.after: Bladesurge can now reset through your caster minion — she closes the gate-Q gap and starts trading on her terms.

edits.before: The lane-control window: trade around Flawless Duet's cooldown and bank small leads. If ahead, freeze and deny; if behind, farm safe.
edits.after: Defiant Dance blunts the physical half of your burst and her Q-reset heals grind your ranged frame down in extended trades.

edits.before: Form-swapping IS the ult — six abilities against his four. Reassess every all-in at 6 — Irelia's ultimate changes the math too.
edits.after: Your R is only the stance-swap; her Trinity proc and a 125s Vanguard's Edge take this window outright — do not contest it.

edits.before: - Irelia Flawless Duet: matchup-defining — Her engage CC. E-knock/dodge it. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Flawless Duet (E): 16s at rank 1 — her stun, and the trade only starts after it lands. - Bladesurge: 10s, but refreshed on a Marked target or a kill. - Defiant Dance (W): 20s at rank 1, and it only cuts physical damage.

edits.before: Track Irelia's Flawless Duet (Stun): Her engage CC. E-knock/dodge it. When it is down — Cannon-Q + hammer her.
edits.after: Defiant Dance cuts only PHYSICAL damage — Thundering Blow is magic, so it lands through her charge at full value.

edits.before: Her engage CC. E-knock/dodge it. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: Her engage CC, 16s at rank 1. Dodge it and the reset chain never starts.

notes: The kit file flags Flawless Duet with 'grounding'; Riot's own description says damaged, stunned and Marked with no grounding, so no grounding claim was written. Unverified. Side/win enum fields are not prose; the length band should not apply to them.
